tool_args.rationale: The saturating sink-gradient law with a square-root correction fits the paid rows to rounding precision. All measured gradients are below the candidate onset of 2.50–2.68, so the onset and siphon strength remain unconstrained and could materially change wide-gradient forecasts. Use the remaining trajectory probe to seek above-onset observations before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the fitted subcritical sink-gradient law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all seven rows to rounding precision, but those rows cannot distinguish a smooth continuation from a supercritical siphon.
The first batch identified the subcritical attenuation but reached only s_grad = 2.35, below the candidate onset.
It does not constrain the high-gradient onset or siphon strength.
